verdict.rationale: Pandoc offers a limited online demo and a WebAssembly-based online demo, which act as sandboxes for trying real conversions. It can also be installed directly through Homebrew, Chocolatey, Docker images or GitHub Actions and run locally with no account or paywall shown in the evidence. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of free/open-source licensing or no-cost use, details on the online demo's limits, and independent corroboration of the demo experience.
